output.thesis: Water, and the feed in it, reaches the roots and the rest drains away: you can see it in a pot cut in half.

beats.learns: A fern in a pot cut in half; a spout tips in.
Water pours in and the top soil darkens.
The roots light up where the water reaches them.
The extra sinks through the gravel and out of the hole.
The saucer holds the run-off; the fern a touch perkier.

book.grammar: One continuous camera: glide in, dip into the cutaway, follow the water down, pull back out. No cuts; the beats are moments of one move.
book.light: Soft daylight from the left, a gentle rim, light fog.
book.palette: Terracotta, soil browns, green fronds; water the only blue.
book.sound: A pour, a soft trickle, a drip into the saucer.
